what.text: This page follows refugees from Vietnam living in France, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 7589 Vietnamese refugees in France, 36.8% of all refugees from Vietnam.
France is the largest host of Vietnamese refugees, followed by the United Kingdom and Germany.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Vietnam, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1995 to 2002.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1995 at its highest figure, 20618 refugees.
The figure has fallen since then.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in France.
These are year-end totals for France only, reported to UNHCR.
